1212667.biography:
Nathan Joseph Fielder (born May 12, 1983) is a Canadian writer, comedian, actor and entrepreneur.

He is best known for creating and starring in the Comedy Central show Nathan for You. Fielder has voiced characters on Rick and Morty, Bob’s Burgers and The Simpsons. He also appears in the films The Night Before and The Disaster Artist, both alongside his longtime friend Seth Rogen.

In 2015, Nathan founded Summit Ice Apparel, a “not-for-profit company dedicated to producing quality outdoor apparel and raising awareness of the Holocaust”, and the endeavor was shown during Season 3 of Nathan for You. All of Summit Ice’s profits go to the Vancouver Holocaust Education Centre in Vancouver, Canada.

2299.biography:
Joshua Daniel "Josh" Hartnett (nato il 21 luglio 1978) è un attore e produttore americano.

Ha attirato l'attenzione del pubblico per la prima volta nel 1997 come "Michael Fitzgerald" nella serie televisiva Cracker. Ha debuttato al cinema nel 1998, recitando insieme a Jamie Lee Curtis in Halloween H20: 20 Years Later. Nello stesso anno, ha ricevuto una nomination agli MTV Movie Award come Miglior Interpretazione Maschile Rivelazione. Hartnett ha guadagnato fama per il ruolo del capitano Danny Walker in Pearl Harbor, e da allora ha recitato per diversi registi noti come Ridley Scott, Brian De Palma, Robert Rodriguez, Tran Anh Hung e Michael Bay.
